## Impulse relay

Input: `pb` (push button). Output: `lamp`. Memory: `pulse`. The exercise starts from a naive two-network solution (a P contact on `pb`, an S coil then an R coil on `lamp`), on which the lamp never lights up.

### Task

1. Simulate the naive solution: observe that the lamp never lights up.
2. Explain why, by going through one cycle network by network on paper.
3. Fix the program: the lamp must toggle only once per press, even if the button is held for several cycles.

texts.turnOnDescription: Edge of pb and lamp off: turn on.
texts.turnOffDescription: Edge of pb and lamp on: turn off.
texts.pulseDescription: A single P contact stores the edge in pulse.
texts.toggleDescription: The lamp changes state on every pulse.
